mechanism.claim: synchronous BVOL and DVOL contraction during two consecutive same-direction, moderate BTC hours with stable OI and non-extreme funding identifies orderly trend propagation after volatility risk is absorbed
mechanism.side: common sign of the two completed-hour BTC returns
mechanism.why_distinct: CVTR trades continuation during implied-volatility contraction and explicitly excludes price, OI, and funding tails; recent candidates traded expansion, crowding, liquidation, or intrahour reversal

clock.decision: T after two consecutive completed UTC hours
clock.volatility: current normalized BVOL and DVOL bodies both strictly negative
clock.price: the two latest completed-hour returns have the same nonzero sign; each absolute return is between its strictly-prior 720h q40 and q75, 672 observations
clock.oi: raw-time backward-asof one-hour change at T lies between strictly-prior 720h q35 and q65, 672 observations
clock.funding: latest nonzero event at or before T has absolute rate <= strictly-prior 270-event q50, 252 observations
clock.trigger: false-to-true onset, prior hour source-valid and consecutive
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT T+5m open, all features available by T
clock.side: common sign of the two completed-hour returns
clock.reservation: global half-open, exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.completed_hour_price: reuse hash-bound OICER completed-hour feature snapshot
source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass
